question: Which goddesses are asked to protect the root of the tongue and the blood?
premises: Kālindī is invoked in relation to the root of the tongue.
Raktinī is invoked to protect the blood.
inference: Kālindī and Raktinī are asked to protect the tongue-root and the blood.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic distribution of the verb over both objects is compact.
plain_english: May Kālindī protect the root of the tongue, and may Raktinī protect the blood.
